purpose: DEPLOYMENT TEST of the clean-lineage artifact only. One release candidate, one run. Not a research evaluation, no variant submissions, no model comparison, no tuning against any result.
where: research/docker/Dockerfile.linux-verify -- python:3.12-slim built from requirements.txt alone, plus crunch-cli 11.11.0. THIS IS PRODUCTION/RT600'S OWN DOCUMENTED HARNESS, kept for exactly this purpose in commit 7746205.
why_not_macos: production/rt600 ships INFER_PARALLELISM = 4. The macOS crunch test runner segfaults LightGBM under forked workers -- a macOS fork+OpenMP hazard, not an artifact defect -- so the macOS gate is unreachable at P>1 and the branch's own record (research/reports/rt600_baseline_submission.md section 16.3) settles parallelism claims in this container instead. The macOS run was executed first and reproduced the documented SIGSEGV exactly; its log is kept beside this file as evidence that the behaviour is the known pre-existing one and not a release regression.
command: docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -e SBR_ROOT=/work -v <claude-wave3>:/work -v <release>:/release -w /work sbr-linux-verify crunch test --main-file /release/submissions/C_ensemble_deployable.py --model-directory /tmp/resources
determinism_check: passed (tolerance 1e-08, re-run on 10% of the data)
payload_self_check: payload ok; source and model verified by sha256
requirements_txt_verified: YES -- the image installs from requirements.txt alone on Python 3.12, the runner's Python. A build failure here is the LB-002 failure, caught before submission.

competition_verified.note: y_test_index.reduced and y_train_index are real-time only and are both present, so this ran against the right competition, not the 2025 one.

score_note: crunch test is a local execution test and returns no score. Nothing was submitted and no leaderboard number was produced, so there was no score available to select on even in principle.

reference_run.what: the PRE-FIX production/rt600 artifact (entrypoint 74894ed1) run through the identical container immediately afterwards, purely as a reference. Not a second release test.
reference_run.meaning: on the competition's reduced test set the accepted m06_loc correction changes nothing at all. The one changed prediction lives on training-store series 5509, which is not in this set.
